Package MFA_GUI

Class Authentification_Method

java.lang.Object
MFA_GUI.Authentification_Method
Direct Known Subclasses:
Mail_Code, SMS_Code
public abstract class Authentification_Method extends Object
The main abstract class providing several method bodies for the upcoming authentification methods. An authentification method basically has to ask information provided by the user. And then, it revifies them.
